runtimeValidationFindings.description: RealEstateListingSchema allows lowPrice > highPrice in AggregateOffer without refinement constraint.
runtimeValidationFindings.recommendedFix: Add .refine(data => data.offers.lowPrice <= data.offers.highPrice, { message: "lowPrice must be <= highPrice" })

runtimeValidationFindings.description: In installed Zod v4.3.6, z.function().args(...).returns(...) is deprecated/removed and throws fatal TypeError: z.function(...).args is not a function.
runtimeValidationFindings.recommendedFix: In Zod 4: z.function({ input: [z.string()], output: z.void() }) or z.custom<Function>(v => typeof v === "function")

runtimeValidationFindings.description: RecirculationTargetAptSchema caps jeonseRatioPercent at 100 (max: 100). In real estate reverse jeonse (역전세/깡통전세), jeonse ratio exceeds 100%, causing runtime parsing crashes.
runtimeValidationFindings.recommendedFix: Relax max constraint: z.number().min(0).max(250) or handle upside-down jeonse explicitly.

runtimeValidationFindings.description: Phase 2 AdTelemetryBeaconSchema emits eventType "FALLBACK_MOUNT" without dwellTimeMs/intersectionRatio/userAgentCategory, but Phase 5 AdTelemetryClosedLoopEventSchema requires "ADBLOCK_FALLBACK" and non-optional metrics. Phase 2 beacons will be rejected with HTTP 400 at /api/ads/click.
incompatibleFields: eventType: Invalid option: expected one of "IMPRESSION"|"UNFILLED"|"ADBLOCK_FALLBACK"|"CLICK"
dwellTimeMs: Invalid input: expected number, received undefined
intersectionRatio: Invalid input: expected number, received undefined
userAgentCategory: Invalid option: expected one of "DESKTOP"|"MOBILE_WEB"|"IN_APP_BROWSER"
runtimeValidationFindings.recommendedFix: Unify telemetry schema: permit optional dwellTimeMs/intersectionRatio for static fallbacks, and harmonize enum to include both or single canonical event names.

stateTransitionFindings.description: Phase 1 FSM does not define f(OBSERVING, TAB_HIDDEN) or f(PAUSED, RATIO_LT_50). Unconditional transition f(PAUSED, TAB_VISIBLE) => VIEWABLE violates Invariant 1 if ratio dropped below 0.50 while tab was hidden.
ViewabilitySlotState holds a strong reference element: HTMLElement in singleton observer state without WeakRef, risking detached DOM memory leaks during fast route/modal transitions.

If TIMEOUT_3S triggers FALLBACK_ACTIVE, and subsequent STATUS_FILLED arrives after 3000ms, f(FALLBACK_ACTIVE, STATUS_FILLED) is undefined, creating risk of double-rendering both AdSense and CPA fallback cards, triggering layout CLS spike.

State CALC_OPEN(type, apt) is declared in S but has 0 incoming and 0 outgoing transitions in f: S x A => S. State COMPARE_OPEN has no transition for CLOSE_MODAL or POPSTATE, dead-ending user navigation.

State TELEMETRY_DISPATCHED is declared in S but never transitioned to (side effect only). Additionally, f(REFRESH_ELIGIBLE, TRIGGER_REFRESH) does not enforce maxRefreshes <= 10 condition from Phase 1 Invariant 3, permitting unbounded infinite refresh loops on backgrounded/long sessions.
